description: Build a Minecraft resource pack from spec files, family files and folders of them in the workspace (/tmp/churn-sfq0snbp): every texture at its "asset" path (or its layout's default: vanilla paths for mobs, item/<name> for items…), with .png.mcmeta, _eyes files, particle definitions, pack.mcmeta for the Minecraft version, and with models: true also the models, block states and item definitions items and blocks need. Writes a .zip or a folder, then checks the result like texel_check_pack.

files.description: Spec files, family files or folders of .json specs, relative to the workspace.

mcVersion.description: Minecraft Java version, e.g. "1.21.4". Default: the latest Texel knows.

models.description: Also write models, block states and item definitions for item, block and plant textures (new items and blocks need them; replaced vanilla textures don't).

namespace.description: Namespace for textures whose "asset" has none. Default "minecraft" (replaces vanilla textures); a mod uses its id.

out.description: Output .zip, or a folder, relative to the workspace.

name: texel_pack
title: Build resource pack
